description:
Lists assets that trade on QX and/or QSwap, most liquid first, or searches by symbol.

Gives each asset's symbol and which markets it trades on ('QX', 'QSwap' or both: only assets on both can be split for a better price).

Returns: { count, assets: [{ id, symbol, category ('contract' shares or 'token'), venues, priceQu, liquidityQu, activity }] }. Prices are QU per unit.

category.description: Only smart-contract shares or only tokens

query.description: Part of a symbol to search for, e.g. 'QD'

name: qmax_list_assets
title: List or search tradable Qubic assets
